title: server: outbound reportAbuse client (protocol-06 §5.9)
description: The hub serves reportAbuse (http.rs:90, decisions .6.31, .6.65) but no provider can send one: PeerClient has no reportAbuse method and the follower has no path from a user report to the hub. Decision mimid-1wgh.21 puts reporting UX out of v1, so confirm scope with Mark first: either a PeerClient method only (for interop tests) or defer with the rest of reporting.
close_reason: Mark: client method only. PeerClient::report_abuse(domain, room_id, body) -> response body on 200 (Endpoint::ReportAbuse, roomId); NotOffered if absent; no follower path or UX (decision .21). Test tests/peer_report_abuse.rs (Haven abuse_report.bin, empty 200 body as the hub sends per .6.65, 422 among rejected statuses) failed to compile before. Six gates pass.
